scope: Final visible draft, deployed JSON and authenticated rendered parity, exact article and action-state blobs, editorial train identities, prior finding/evidence chronology, ADR attribution, held-action receipts, owner and merge gates, current next actions, and review discovery. Read-only review; no article acceptance, action admission or settlement, readiness, merge, workflow dispatch, runtime, or scheduling authority.

findings.title: The train count includes an unrelated article PR and commit
findings.location: The summary and lines 11-25 say seven commits across five PRs completed the October 27 train and that every listed commit belongs to it.
findings.explanation: PR #486 is the October 28 article publication, merged as 1fc55540. The October 27 train is #485, #487, #488 and #489, with six mainline commits; including #486 creates the seven/five totals.
findings.correction: Report four train PRs and six train commits. Keep #486 and 1fc5554 as separate October 28 article publication activity in the same reporting window.

findings.title: PR 485 is paired with an impossible source and blob identity
findings.location: Lines 17 and 43 say PR #485 reviewed source commit 1fc55540 and blob baae401d.
findings.explanation: The registered October 27 review and PR #485 bind blob baae401d to source ea5be44c. Commit 1fc55540 introduced the October 28 article and cannot reproduce the named October 27 blob.
findings.correction: Use source ea5be44c16c2bf73ba19484cb5a9c5fdf00b6cf6 with blob baae401dd804458021bbf6bf3dc91e43328a8173.

findings.title: The prior review and action state are materially mischaracterized
findings.location: Line 17 reduces the seven findings to four different categories and says #487 made the action card reflect verified current state.
findings.explanation: The source review separately records held-action state reversal, byte-versus-token confusion, unsupported commands, invented dependencies and a false acceptance prerequisite. PR #487 says the three original commands remain unverified and non-dispatchable.
findings.correction: Preserve the actual finding classes and say #487 labels the original candidate commands and context unverified while correcting the article prose.

findings.title: The evidence parsing failure is described as a date path bug
findings.location: Lines 17 and 37 say a date string at the head of a path segment was misread as a repository name.
findings.explanation: PR #488 records a descriptive pre-#571 temporal prefix, title-case Core #571 and exact --pr N --repo R target handling. It does not describe a date string or path segment.
findings.correction: Describe the actual candidate-reference ambiguity around pre-#571, case and exact flag pairs without inventing a path/date mechanism.

findings.title: ADR 0037 and ADR 0038 do not define the claimed review sequence
findings.location: Lines 31 and 43 attribute an independent-review ordering rule and source-pin requirement to ADR-0037 and ADR-0038.
findings.explanation: ADR-0037 defines the OAuth proxy, acceptance PR and manual merge gate. ADR-0038 defines feedback-driven revision CI and human review before merge. Neither ADR defines the independent review registry, source commit/blob registration or the asserted four-PR sequence.
findings.correction: Attribute source-pinned reviews to the current review schema and service. Present the October 27 order as the observed supervised sequence unless an accepted decision makes it universal.

findings.title: Workstation PRs 5 and 7 have an explicit merge blocker
findings.location: Lines 59 and 85 say Workstation #4 through #7 have no merge blockers and are unblocked pending operator review.
findings.explanation: PRs #5 and #7 both say they overlap two files, require #5 to land first, require #7 to be updated afterward, and forbid merging either current head without reconciliation.
findings.correction: Preserve the documented #5 to #7 ordering and reconciliation gate. Keep #4 and #6 separate absent their own dependency evidence.

findings.title: Issue 386 had a concrete diagnostic and measured non-token stop
findings.location: Lines 67 and 84 make the October 26 storage cap the active context-budget anchor and say no next concrete step was recorded.
findings.explanation: The October 26 measured run fit the provider token gate and stopped at ranked-shortlist-incomplete. Before article generation, the October 27 acceptance receipt recorded a 160159-token proposer input, an evidence request for missing core #572 lines, no Opus call and a concrete next diagnostic for source selection.
findings.correction: Retain the 64 KiB overflow as earlier history, then report the later storage repair, measured token fit and shortlist/evidence-selection stops with their recorded diagnostics.

findings.title: The visible next action is completed and uses unsupported commands
findings.location: Lines 53, 78-79 and 90 call #490 the live critical path and present /review-pr, /triage-pr and /review-suggestions as candidate commands.
findings.explanation: PR #490 later merged, followed by correction #498, acceptance #502 and final review #503. The daily-cycle index defines the real supervised workflows but exposes none of the named slash-command interfaces.
findings.correction: Preserve candidate IDs and historical text as unverified custody, not dispatchable commands. Qualify #490 as completed after publication and route remaining work through the real supervised surfaces.

findings.title: The first and reference implementation claims lack a census
findings.location: Lines 31 and 49 call the October 27 sequence the first clean full cycle and the reference implementation for future runs.
findings.explanation: The four PRs establish this sequence, but their discussions and ADR-0037/0038 do not define the population of earlier cycles, a comparison method or an owner decision adopting it as universal. The acceptance run also retained held actions after an evidence request.
findings.correction: Describe the observed sequence and artifacts. Drop first and universal-reference language unless a bounded historical census and owner decision support it.

findings.title: The eight-day triage threshold has no owner record
findings.location: Lines 55, 78 and 82 say eight days without a verdict is the threshold for explicit triage and recommend assigning a named reviewer with a deadline.
findings.explanation: Morning Cockpit PR #60 has generated cleanup text and green CI but no owner-adopted eight-day policy, reviewer deadline or merge disposition. Silence does not create one.
findings.correction: Report owner disposition and merge readiness as unknown. Ask for merge, close or a review checkpoint without inventing a threshold or deadline.
